{{Top|leg}}
'''Headset controllers''' were used to play the [[Hologame/Legends|hologame]] [[Declination/Legends|Declination]]. They allowed the player to use their thoughts to control the [[holograph]]ic representation of a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] through a simulated [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]].
